subject.title: Replacement for accidentally closed #3102: ClawScan backend error persists despite clean VirusTotal

question: Should the production security owner repair and requeue only these artifact-bound jobs, or first pause write-back and treat the VirusTotal terminal-state mismatch as a potentially systemic scanner defect?
rationale: Resolving the failed jobs requires production access and determines whether a security verdict may be written after operational repair; repository evidence cannot safely authorize that boundary decision.

options.title: Inspect then repair
options.body: Inspect both jobs and their VirusTotal state transitions, then requeue the immutable artifact only after confirming the security pipeline’s normal completion criteria.

options.title: Investigate system-wide first
options.body: Pause artifact write-back and audit recent ClawScan jobs for the same terminal-state mismatch before repairing any individual result.

options.title: Decline manual recovery
options.body: Leave the artifact without a final security result until a repository-level worker fix is identified and deployed.

recommendation.title: Inspect then repair
recommendation.body: Inspect both jobs and their VirusTotal state transitions, then requeue the immutable artifact only after confirming the security pipeline’s normal completion criteria.

likelyOwner.reason: The available feature history most directly connects this person to the owner-authorized artifact scan and result-submission lifecycle.
